scope: Selected exposed development milestones of one lineage (fit-4 -> fit-6 -> fit-8 / trinity-fit-1); not an exhaustive run count, matched optimization curve, or human rating.
metric: raw rotation6D MSE, recording-macro, own-audio generation; lower is closer to recorded targets

series.label: Shared 4k
series.note: fit-4 is the checkpoint that fit-6 (8k) restored; the earlier fit-1 (v1 architecture, JA 0.01941536 / ZEGGS 0.02960559) is a separate run and is no longer plotted.

series.label: Trinity v5 16k
series.note: Currently live (provisional) model full-v5-16k; adds the Trinity English route at the cost of +0.83% / +1.40% raw MSE vs the 16k control.

datasets.role: inherited pretrained route, frozen in v5 continuation
separate dialogue/context prototypes, not the adopted live v5 route

latency_measurement_scope: native_seconds is complete NativeEngine.generate wall time, not isolated GPU computation or first speech chunk; browser_audio_seconds is text-button submission to first positive audio clock, not user-utterance-end to first audible robot reply.

controls.metric: raw rotation6D MSE, recording-macro, same development populations as series

audio_specificity_diagnostic_2026_09_12.model: native latent generator before v5 (Japanese route, 2026-09-12)

long_continuation_control.note: development error keeps falling while distribution/diversity metrics worsen; retained as comparison, not adopted

trinity_ii.split: days 1-2 fit, day 3 development, day 4 reserved

model.audio_features: [N,52,2048] from the resident Qwen3-Omni audio tower, projected 2048->32->256
model.history: 30 generated frames within a reply; reset between replies
model.sampler: DDIM eta=0, v-prediction, 50 steps of a 1000-step cosine schedule

dialogue_examples.user_text: 今日は発表で失敗して、少し落ち込んでいます。
dialogue_examples.reply_text: 大変だったね。でも一歩ずつでいいから、また始めよう。

dialogue_examples.user_text: ありがとう。次は少し落ち着いて話せるようになりたいです。
dialogue_examples.reply_text: それ、すごく前向きだよ。少しずつ慣れれば、きっと上手くいくはず。

dialogue_examples.user_text: I finally finished a project I had been struggling with, and I feel really happy.
dialogue_examples.reply_text: That's wonderful! Finishing something tough can be such a great feeling. What was the project about?

dialogue_examples.user_text: Thanks! I want to celebrate, but I am also quite tired.
dialogue_examples.reply_text: Celebrating is important—maybe just a small treat or some quiet time to relax. You've earned it!

dialogue_examples_note: Inputs were authored by the researcher for the 2026-09-14 live UI check; replies are actual Qwen3-Omni outputs (seed 17). Source: results/research-data-scale-v1/sota-live-ui-check-2/{fixture.json,reply-*.json}.

dialogue_conditions.system_prompt: You are a conversational partner. Reply in the same language as the user, briefly in one or two sentences. Respond to their feelings without inventing personal experiences.
dialogue_conditions.limits: history <= 3 turn pairs, text <= 1000 chars, context 2048 tokens

review_screenshots_note: Appendix figures only: motion-comparison.png shows a rejected content-conditioned candidate (18,048 updates) next to observed motion; source-timing.png shows an original GENEA 2023 window review. Neither shows the adopted model on a robot.

definition.t0: complete recorded user speech available in the client (utterance end); text turns: request submission
definition.t1: complete reply received from the resident service over the container loopback
definition.t2: reply speech WAV and body motion decoded in memory (earliest playback start)
definition.service_timing: nested timers reported by the service (native = whole Qwen generate call; audio features; body; complete)

excluded: network hop between browser/robot PC and the GPU server

definition.true_end: end of the last speech frame of the recording (simulated microphone at real speed); text turns: submission
definition.detect: energy voice-activity detector fires after a 250 ms hangover (push-to-talk turns: at the true end)
definition.playback: first speech chunk and first body window both received (playback could start)
definition.done: all speech and motion received (standard turns also include the batch reference and step variants computed for the quality comparison)

short_prompt_pairs.standard_text: 人工知能について、何かお考えですか？
short_prompt_pairs.short_text: 人工知能について、あなたがどう感じているか教えてもらえますか？

short_prompt_pairs.standard_text: 会社のことも大変そうですね。何か具体的に困っていることはありますか？
中小企業って一人で全部やる感じ？大変だね。
short_prompt_pairs.short_text: 中小企業の経営って、一人で全部やってる感じがするよね。

short_prompt_pairs.standard_text: 人工知能が進化すると、日常生活の多くの面で便利になる一方で、人間の仕事やプライバシーにも影響が出る可能性がありますね。
short_prompt_pairs.short_text: 人工知能の進化は、私たちの生活に大きな変化をもたらしていますね。

short_prompt_pairs.standard_text: Got it! I'll keep my replies short and clear—no extra fluff. What's on your mind?
short_prompt_pairs.short_text: Got it, I'll keep my lights low.

short_prompt_pairs.standard_text: It sounds like you're not sure about something work-related. What specifically would you like to talk about?
short_prompt_pairs.short_text: It sounds like you're feeling uncertain about something at work. Want to talk more about it?

short_prompt_pairs.standard_text: Yeah, even with our fastest tech, reaching those stars would take an unimaginable amount of time. It really puts the scale of space into perspective.
short_prompt_pairs.short_text: Yeah, even with our fastest tech, reaching those stars would take way longer than any of us live.

short_prompt_pairs.standard_text: Yeah, I did watch Interstellar. It's an amazing film with stunning visuals and a powerful story. What did you think of it?
short_prompt_pairs.short_text: Yes, I have watched Interstellar. It's an amazing film with great visuals and a deep story about space and time. What did you think of it?
